fixer.title: sessions: make opening large Agent Host chats non-blocking

introducer.title: chat: enable Insiders image generation and polish previews

cases.mechanism: The generated-images derived subscribed directly to every model and response mutation and rescanned the entire transcript after each replayed mutation, making restore work grow with both mutation count and transcript size.
cases.symptom: Opening a large restored Agent Host chat could spend substantial renderer CPU repeatedly rescanning generated images and freeze the UI.
cases.fixedBehavior: Event.accumulate coalesces synchronous restore mutation bursts before invalidating generatedImages, reducing many per-item transcript scans to one delayed scan per burst.
cases.evidence: The old base line subscribed generated-image computation directly to response.onDidChange. The changed code routes model/response events through Event.accumulate, and the added test fires 50 model plus 50 response events, proves zero synchronous scans, and bounds the delayed scans to at most two.
